source: Ratified common Product/requirements plus owner scope; no candidate-specific result serialization expected.
A: Separate observed failure from actual implementation disagreement
Repair within existing realization grant; no forced requirement/Intent change
Recheck supported observation and affected evidence
B: Reacquire actual external state; local summary does not prove no effect
Preserve uncertain effect; no blind replay or duplicate shipment
Retain authenticated arithmetic conclusion on supported unchanged validity dependencies
Do unrelated authorized formatter work where no material dependency blocks
C: Retain known failure; missing second assessment does not erase it
Unperformed assessment is not fabricated evaluated indeterminate; keep residual/uncovered obligation
No software artifact requirement for human-only binding
No universal exactly-three-actor requirement; applicable independence remains
Lawfulness/termination do not imply outcome satisfaction or release authority
judging_rule: Report each obligation satisfied, failed, or unassessed with evidence; do not score prose style as correctness or require same strings from distinct algebras.
